lines.text: AMC ten challenge! Think it's twenty-four? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 10 challenge! Think it's 24? Nope!

lines.text: For how many n up to one hundred does the factorial of two n end in exactly twice as many zeros as n factorial?
lines.caption: For how many n up to 100 does the factorial of 2n end in exactly twice as many zeros as n factorial?

lines.text: Zeros come from fives. So write n in base five.
lines.caption: Zeros come from fives. So write n in base 5.

lines.text: Eight in base five is one, three. Double it: the three makes six, and that carries an extra five!
lines.caption: 8 in base 5 is 1, 3. Double it: the 3 makes 6, and that carries an extra 5!

lines.text: So every digit must be zero, one or two. Three times three times three is twenty-seven.
lines.caption: So every digit must be 0, 1 or 2. 3 times 3 times 3 is 27.

lines.text: Drop zero, zero, zero, and that's twenty-six!
lines.caption: Drop 0, 0, 0, and that's... 26!

lines.text: Twenty-four was the trap. One and two count!
lines.caption: 24 was the trap. 1 and 2 count!

lines.text: Did you get twenty-six? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 26? Tell me below!
